thread:
ana (PM): Quick proposal — narrow observability MVP to three compact templates: cost-by-route dashboard, a latency+trace hook for hot paths, and an error-regression widget with lightweight alerts. Goal: ship high-impact wins in 2 sprints. @jorge can you confirm infra deps?
jorge (engineering): Seems doable. Cost dashboard depends on token attribution data; we need one extra request tag (customer_route) and a small metrics schema change. Backend + query layer work ~8 dev-days.
ruth (sre): Tracing hook should be event-based sampling for high-volume models to avoid blowup. Recommend 1% default + full-capture on error. Need sampling config + span-id KV exposure in traces.
sam (design): I can produce compact widgets — small cards with 95th/p50 latency, token-cost, error-rate, with a collapsed details pane containing top traces and example requests. Will do mobile-friendly variants.
maria (cs): Customers X and Y requested per-deployment and per-route cost slicing plus anomaly CSV export. This matches our targets — pilot-ready feature will help renewals. Add a "billing-export" toggle for admins.
nana (PM): (typo note) — meant ana above ^^
nana (PM): Proposed launch criteria: templates live in Console, 1 pilot customer using cost dashboard + one GA-level docs page, auto-annotation of traces for persistent errors (>0.5% for 24h). Target: end of sprint 5.
jorge (engineering): Implementation risks: request-tagging rollout requires a feature-flagged deploy and optional backfill to populate historical dashboards. Backfill is heavy — estimate >3 infra-days. Can we defer backfill to post-GA?
nana (PM): Defer backfill for GA. Show cost data only from ship time. Keep tagging behind FF and gradually roll.
ruth (sre): For tracing defaults, low overhead is critical. Example config to land in ops docs:
```yaml
tracing:
  default_sampler: 0.01
  on_error_full: true
  error_threshold: 0.005  # 0.5%
```
sam (design): UI copy for sampling toggles: 'Capture full traces on errors' and 'Default sampling rate'. Also propose a compact explainer modal for cost attribution caveats.
maria (cs): Pilot ask: make CSV export include per-route breakdown, timeframe, and token-cost columns. Customers do offline joins.
jorge (engineering): We'll add CSV export to dashboard service; +2 days. Also need a small endpoint to resolve route -> model mapping.
nana (PM): Prioritization: P1 for Dedicated/Private customers (they asked for it), P2 for Hosted. Rollout policy: internal -> pilot (2 customers) -> GA.
deploy-bot: CI passed for feature-branch/add-dashboard-templates #432 :white_check_mark:
ruth (sre): Follow-up on alerts: alerts should group by error signature and include direct trace link. Consider rate-limited alerting to avoid noise.
nana (PM): Agreed. Action items: @jorge spike on tagging + route mapping (due 2026-03-30), @sam wireframes by 2026-03-24, @ruth sampling-defaults doc by 2026-03-25, @maria recruit pilot customers this week.
maria (cs): On it — reaching out to Customer X and Y today.
jorge (engineering): Ack.
sam (design): Ack.
ruth (sre): Ack.
